title: Dedupe Stripe refund webhooks (fix double refunds, INC-2291)
summary: Adds dedupe for Stripe `charge.refunded` webhooks so a redelivered event does not credit the customer twice (INC-2291, closes #377) (author).
New additive `processed_events` table (migration 0043) with a UNIQUE index on `event_id`; refund apply and event record share one DB transaction (author, confirmed in diff).
Since the last assessment (b2b2b2b): insert now stores `event.id`, index made UNIQUE, seeded duplicate test replaced by real redelivery + concurrent-delivery tests.

why: Rule 4: recheck at full depth (3/3 risk paths re-read at f6f6f6f); G1-G5 all PASS; no open BLOCKER/MAJOR.
Operational Risk 7 is covered: Verification Confidence 9 and an author rollback story (additive migration; revert + drop table).
Previous blockers D1 (wrong dedupe key) and V1 (masking test) are RESOLVED with cited changes.

comment_draft:
Thanks for the quick turnaround on this one. The dedupe key now matches (`event.id` on both sides), the UNIQUE index closes the concurrent case, and the new redelivery and concurrent tests cover exactly what was missing.

A few small follow-ups, none blocking:
- [ ] Update the PR body's Verification section to list the 4 current tests and run 9960 (it still cites 3 tests / run 9911).
- [ ] Consider catching the unique-violation in `handleRefundEvent` and returning `duplicate`, so concurrent redeliveries don't show up as 500s in error alerts. Fine to leave as-is if 500s on this route don't page anyone.

I'll take one more look at the route's error handling and then update my review.
